content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Juice, Apple is a 100 % natural apple juice specially formulated for children from 1 year old. It contains no added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors and is enriched with vitamin C and iron to support growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Apple juice is one of the most popular toddler drinks thanks to its mild taste and high nutritional value.
The juice is made from selected apple varieties grown without pesticides.
Each 100 ml provides about 45 mg of vitamin C – more than 50 % of the daily requirement for children.
The juice is pasteurized at low temperature to preserve maximum vitamins and aroma compounds.
Packaging is made from safe, reusable plastic.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids iron absorption and protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of natural sugars
items.content: Contains fructose and glucose that provide quick energy without added sugar.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron is essential for hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia in children.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: A small amount of dietary fiber helps regulate bowel movements.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The juice contributes to daily fluid intake, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Apple allergy
items.content: A small number of children may experience an allergic reaction to apple juice.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate a sensitive stomach in some toddlers; diluting the juice with water is recommended.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no added sugar is present, natural sugars are still there; intake should be monitored.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the juice chilled in small portions (50–100 ml) right after meals or between meals. For younger children, dilute the juice with water in a 1:1 ratio.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze.
